summary: A three-bedroom semi-detached home available with no onward chain, making it an ideal purchase for first-time buyers or investors.
description:
LOUNGE Spacious lounge boasting large windows at both ends for excellent natural light, with durable laminate flooring throughout.

KITCHEN Spacious kitchen fitted with a range of wall and base units, plumbing for a washing machine, a fitted oven with overhead extractor fan and ample space for a dining table.

MASTER BEDROOM Spacious master bedroom with a full row of fitted wardrobes, storage cupboard and a double-glazed window to the front aspect.

BEDROOM Generous second double bedroom featuring a front aspect view and plenty of space for freestanding furniture.

BEDROOM Third bedroom, ideal for a home office or nursery

EXTERNAL

Enjoying a pleasant outlook over a green to the front, the property also features a rear yard and is conveniently located for access to the A1, offering direct routes to Durham and Newcastle.
